sloka: एतान्सर्वान्समानीय मन्त्रयित्वा च लक्ष्मण ।हयं लक्षणसम्पन्नं विमोक्ष्यामि समाधिना ।। ७.९१.३ ॥
transliteration: etānsarvānsamānīya mantrayitvā ca lakṣmaṇa ।hayaṁ lakṣaṇasampannaṁ vimokṣyāmi samādhinā ।। 7.91.3 ॥

translations.english: O Lakshmana, having assembled all these and consulted with them, I shall release a horse endowed with auspicious marks, with proper ritual observance.
